analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but has not recovered above 50. MACD histogram is improving but still negative. 5-day low support confirmed, but below 20-day high weakens upward momentum. No significant movement with +1.14% daily change. Current price $161.18 is near swing resistance at $161.45. With ATR $9.42, a 1.0x ATR stop loss at $151.76 yields a risk/reward ratio below 1.5. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
